verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair thing to ask of a POS and inventory product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk-edit or multi-item batch capability. Quick counts, scanner-based shipment receiving and Sidekick-created stock transfers are separate per-item or task-specific features, not documented bulk operations across many items. The GraphQL Admin API access from extensions is only a developer building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
